source: instances/runtime-rooted/express-b2-fanin-500.json (patch reconstructed from gold_patch; original in neat-agent-bench/patches/B2.patch)
size_rationale: Medium because the cause sits one step away from every endpoint the prompt lists, in the toJSON model plugin shared by all models; it is one line in one file and static reading finds it once the shared serializer is suspected, so it is not big.
prompt: Multiple unrelated endpoints (POST /v1/auth/register, POST /v1/auth/login, GET /v1/users, GET /v1/users/:id) all return 500. Creating and reading users both fail.

root_cause.detail: `ret._id.toStrng()` is not a function: the shared toJSON transform throws a TypeError whenever a document is serialized, so every endpoint that returns a user or token document responds 500.

fail_to_pass: tests/integration/auth.test.js > Auth routes > POST /v1/auth/register > should return 201 and successfully register user if request data is ok
tests/unit/models/plugins/toJSON.plugin.test.js > toJSON plugin > should replace _id with id
oracle.cmd: npx jest tests/integration/auth.test.js tests/unit/models/plugins/toJSON.plugin.test.js -t 'should return 201 and successfully register user if request data is ok|should replace _id with id'
